QuestInfo.name: Carta's Worn Bracelet
QuestInfo.1: #p2060100# said that the will power needs to be made into medicine for it to be absorbed back. However, she said she won't do it unless I bring her #b#t4031463##k.  She says I can get it from #b#p2040050##k.

0.0: The Will was broken into pieces and is, as you can imagine, quite difficult to re-assemble. I don't have to help you with that. It's not easy to make such medicine. It's not what a witch is supposed to do. \r\n#b#L0#That's because you threw it away into the cracked dimension.#l
0.2: ...I can't do it any more. I tell you this. Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia and Robeira in El Nath can't do it. It's me, #p2060100#, who can do it. \n\n#b#L0#(Is Carta that great?)#l
0.3: It's fine if you don't want to. What else are you going to do with the Pieces of Will? *laughs*

yes.0: Good. Griffey would have my bracelet. It's worn out. Don't bring it as it is. Give it to Wandering Researcher, #p2040050# so that he will compound it with #t4011002#. When you bring me a perfect Mithril bracelet, I'll give your Will back to you.

1.0: Hello! Magic, metal, plants and mineral... I'm studying everything! If you have any questions, I'll help you.

item.0: You couldn't get #t4031463#. I can't give you the medicine.
